meta.title: Orpigo — Read faster. Remember more.
meta.description: Orpigo is an RSVP + ORP speed reading app that shows your PDFs one word at a time, right at your eye's focal point. iOS and Android.

reader.label: Speed reader. Space: play or pause. Arrows: word and speed.

hero.text: Keep your eyes on the red letter. Orpigo shows your PDFs one word at a time, right at this point. Your eyes stop travelling along the line and simply focus. The red letter in each word is where your eye recognises it fastest. You choose the pace below: anywhere from 100 to 1000 words per minute. Punctuation gets a short breath. Your place is remembered. Now get the app for your own PDFs.
hero.title:
Read faster.
Remember more.
hero.lead: Orpigo shows your PDFs one word at a time, at your eye's focal point. No scanning along lines. You just read.
hero.hint: Tap the reader or press Space.
